{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Confirm the number of non-null values in body_mass_g
print('Non-null count for body_mass_g:', penguins['body_mass_g'].count())

# Compute the mean body mass, dropping missing values
mean_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].mean()
print('Mean body mass (grams):', mean_body_mass)"}
